name: Outlined cartoon
blurb: Inked outlines, big heads, sparkle crosses
mechanism: Every flat-filled shape sits inside a warm near-black ink line that varies by role (2.5 px silhouettes, 2 px parts, 1.5 px details), and every interior mark is a tapered sliver that swells in the middle and ends in two points, so the drawing reads as inked by hand.

palette.name: Mint row

line: Ink #1e1b1b strokes with round caps and joins: 2.5 px silhouettes, 2 px hands and parts, 1.5 px inner details; folds are tapered filled slivers 1.1-2.4 px (brows 3.6-4); decor 1.6-2 px.
rules: Outline every fill in warm near-black, three weights by role
Draw folds, brows and splits as tapered slivers, never strokes
Big head, huge white eyes, thick brows, open smile, blush
One character, one big hero prop, joined by the action
One sparkle cluster plus rings, dots and one square
Transparent card, no ground line, no shadows or gradients
